name: Indo Hokke Hotel, Rajgir
why_pick: Built by an Indo-Japanese consortium for the Buddhist pilgrimage circuit — 44 rooms, a meditation hall with a Buddha image next to the restaurant, Western and Japanese-style prayer rooms, and a Japanese hot-spring bath house. The architecture is the cleanest fusion of Buddhist stupa motif and Indian sandstone you will find this side of Bodh Gaya.
what_to_know: 12 km from the Nalanda Mahavihara ruins on Virayatan Road, Rajgir; the hotel arranges car transfers and Buddhist-circuit guides. Restaurant serves both Japanese vegetarian and Indian thali.
best_for: Buddhist pilgrims, history-minded travellers pairing Nalanda with Rajgir's Vulture Peak and Venuvana, couples who want quiet over flash
address_or_landmark: Virayatan Road, Near Viraytan, Rajgir 803116, Nalanda District, Bihar
